name: opensubtitles-2018-ru-full-min10-outside-onboard-v3
scope: Cyrillic forms [а-яё]{3,} plus the eight single-letter Russian words of the OpenSubtitles 2018 Russian full frequency list with count >= 10 that are absent from the frozen onboard ru_RU.lm vocabulary; two-letter forms are refused because the onboard vocabulary already holds the real ones and the rest are subtitle noise that disguises short commands; loaded as extra words with the synthetic fallback frequency by the training and evaluation reference models (tools/reference_lexicon.py) and, once a model measured with it is installed, by the engine.
